corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez verb is ይትፈለጡ (1st order ፈ, matching L07 ወይትፈለጡ), not 5th order ፌ.
The image and Ge'ez/Amharic morphology clearly show ባሕርያተ ሥጋ (4th order ባ with shorter left leg), matching ባሕርየ ነፍስ on the next line.
Translating the Ge'ez ዝናም ለመጺእ ('for rain to come'), the Amharic verbal noun is ለመዝነም ('to rain'), printed with 1st order ነ.
Classical Ge'ez preposition ላዕለ ('upon/concerning') is printed with 4th order ላ.
The Ge'ez noun meaning 'compulsion/constraint' is ኵርህ (ending in 6th order ህ, በኵርህ), which is clearly visible in the image.
